module: Bridge between the vehicle and the simplified powertrain control buttons shown in the UI. setButton sends the UI event `ChangePowerTrainButtons` (create, update or remove a button); updateButtons asks powertrain and the controllers to republish their buttons. The powertrain/controller modules use it, a modder can add their own buttons to it.
notes: The `players` field sent to the UI is the sorted list of seated player indices (playerInfo.seatedPlayers).
The color is normalized: if it is a non-empty string without a leading '#', a '#' is added; otherwise (nil or other type) it becomes nil.
onClickCallback is passed as is to the UI (onClick field); it is a value the UI will send back, presumably a Lua code string (inferred from code, not verified here).

setButton.desc: Publishes a simplified control button to the UI via guihooks.trigger('ChangePowerTrainButtons', {...}).

ringValue.desc: Value of the button's progress ring (passed as is).

onClickCallback.desc: Callback passed to the UI (onClick field).

updateButtons.desc: Calls powertrain.updateSimpleControlButtons() then controller.updateSimpleControlButtons() so that each module republishes its buttons.
